## Checklist

- [ ] Metadata table(s) updated in every changed document (Version, Status, Last Updated)
- [ ] RFC 2119 keywords used correctly (capitalized only in normative statements; interpretation clause present)
- [ ] Shared Taxonomy IDs used (P/X/AL/RT/ROLE/CL/ART/EV) — no competing scales or redefined Glossary terms
- [ ] Vendor-neutral: no AI vendors, models, or commercial products named in normative text
- [ ] All links are relative and resolve; cross-references include Document IDs
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md Unreleased section updated (Class 2/3 changes)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO, `git commit -s`) and follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Affiliations relevant to this change disclosed per GOVERNANCE.md §7 (or none apply)
